scenarios.input: 客户发来截图：保单申请需要签名，但客户说「我签了呀，怎么还说要签？」

scenarios.input: Underwriting requested driver's license copy. Client says "I already sent it last week."
scenarios.notes: Broker should confirm what was received; may need to resend or escalate to underwriting.

scenarios.input: Notice: Policy will be cancelled in 7 days due to non-payment. Last notice.
scenarios.notes: Immediate broker action; client needs to pay or contact carrier.

scenarios.input: Your policy is pending issuance. We will notify you within 5-7 business days.

scenarios.input: Underwriting needs clarification on prior claims. Please respond within 10 days.

scenarios.input: Renewal reminder: Your policy renews in 45 days. No action needed at this time.
scenarios.notes: Informational; optional broker outreach for retention.
